evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Forward-looking cadence commitment plus a counterfactual principle framing unrehearsed rollbacks as nonexistent — attention on future possibility and abstract policy.
Scheduling label names a concrete recurring event yet to occur — planned, not yet actual.
Attribution of current ownership to a named individual — settled present fact at concrete level.
